mentions.name: Untitled Playdate game
mentions.description: A game developed part-time for the Playdate handheld console over the past year+, written mostly in Lua with low-level C used to push the device's hardware boundaries. The author highlights Playdate's constraints as creatively freeing and recommends the platform as a game dev hobby.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a game for playdate, part time for the last year+.
